Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.client

Interface ClientVoiceApi

public interface ClientVoiceApi
Client-side Cozy Voice Chat API for the local player, from CozyVoiceApi.get().client(). Only available on the physical client.

Getters are thread-safe and cheap enough to call every frame (e.g. from a HUD overlay). Methods that change state or open screens must be called on the client (render) thread.

To draw your own HUD, register a normal Forge overlay (RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent) and read the state from here.

Since:
1.1.0
